title: classifyTrackerTask
responsibility: Classify Tracker work and infer its task type, identify its automatic model route, eligibility and explicit hardness, and set initial Sol effort.

inputs.name: trackerTaskRoute.item
inputs.description: Tracker item whose title and notes describe the requested activity.

inputs.name: classifyTrackerTask.item
inputs.description: Tracker item whose title and notes determine the work type.

inputs.name: sizeOf.item
inputs.description: Tracker item whose title and notes determine the work size.

inputs.name: projectOf.item
inputs.description: Tracker item with optional project and agent names.

inputs.name: floorReasons.item
inputs.description: Tracker item whose fields determine minimum model eligibility.

inputs.name: isHarnessModule.item
inputs.description: Tracker item checked for Harness project and module scope.

inputs.name: isVisualInspection.item
inputs.description: Tracker item whose title is tested for visual review wording.

inputs.name: solEffort.kind
inputs.description: Classified work type used to select reasoning effort.

inputs.name: solEffort._size
inputs.description: Estimated work size retained for existing callers. Initial effort depends on difficulty.

inputs.name: isExplicitlyHard.item
inputs.description: Tracker item whose title or notes may carry an explicit hard marker.

inputs.name: isLightClaudeWork.item
inputs.description: Tracker item whose title may describe a watch, reminder or check.

inputs.name: isLightClaudeWork.kind
inputs.description: Classified work type: docs, tests and small chores qualify.

inputs.name: isLightClaudeWork.size
inputs.description: Estimated work size; only small chores qualify as mechanical units.

inputs.name: isTrackerTaskType.value
inputs.description: A --kind word or stored value to test against the task types.

outputs.name: classifyTrackerTask
outputs.description: Work type matched from the title first and then notes, defaulting to feature.

outputs.name: sizeOf
outputs.description: Small, medium or large work size based on text length and list items.

outputs.name: projectOf
outputs.description: Explicit project, agent fallback, or null if both are absent.

outputs.name: floorReasons
outputs.description: Sensitivity, database and promotion reasons that constrain model eligibility.

outputs.name: isHarnessModule
outputs.description: Whether this item qualifies as Harness module work.

outputs.name: isExplicitlyHard
outputs.description: True when the title or notes mark the work hard.

outputs.name: isLightClaudeWork
outputs.description: True for tests, docs, small mechanical chores and watch or check items.

outputs.name: isVisualInspection
outputs.description: Whether the title requests inspection of a visual artifact.

outputs.name: solEffort
outputs.description: High reasoning effort for hard tasks and medium for other initial Sol runs.

outputs.name: trackerTaskRoute
outputs.description: Live deployment, computer use, visual work or the default route, in priority order.
